title.zh: 将伊莎贝拉省Cabagan市镇Tallag村的名称正式变更为Biuag村的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio Tallag in the Municipality of Cabagan, Province of Isabela, to Barrio Biuag
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio Tallag in the Municipality of Cabagan, Province of Isabela, to Barrio Biuag
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Barrio Tallag tại Thị trấn Cabagan, Tỉnh Isabela thành Barrio Biuag
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อบารริโอ Tallag ในเทศบาล Cabagan, จังหวัด Isabela เป็นบารริโอ Biuag
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Barrio Tallag di Kotamadya Cabagan, Provinsi Isabela menjadi Barrio Biuag
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Barrio Tallag di Perbandaran Cabagan, Wilayah Isabela menjadi Barrio Biuag

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1971/ra_6182_1971.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Barrio Tallag in the Municipality of Cabagan, Province of Isabela, is hereby changed to Barrio Biuag.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 19, 1971.
